posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina Kaif shared a tender May photo dump with baby Vihaan while celebrating husband Vicky Kaushal's 38th birthday, even as buzz swirls around a possible Raajneeti 2 reunion.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit Dosanjh's Imtiaz Ali film Main Vaapas Aaunga hit theatres June 12 to glowing reviews, while his record-breaking AURA World Tour keeps rolling across continents.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia Bhatt is everywhere this month — the Alpha teaser from YRF's Spy Universe dropped June 10, and her Bhansali epic Love & War with Ranbir and Vicky is locked for January 2027.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka Chopra is shooting SS Rajamouli's globetrotting epic Varanasi and was just named the No. 3 most valuable celebrity in Fortune India's 2026 ranking.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: Shah Rukh Khan's much-awaited King, directed by Siddharth Anand and co-starring daughter Suhana and Deepika Padukone, is locked for a December 24 release.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena Kapoor Khan wrapped Meghna Gulzar's thriller Daayra and is reportedly joining Salman Khan's Raj & DK superhero film, between vacation chronicles with Taimur and Jeh.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha Kapoor's next, Eetha, is set for an August 28 release, though she's reportedly recovering from an injury sustained during the shoot.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika Padukone, expecting her second child with Ranveer Singh, wrapped the Cape Town schedule of King and lines up Atlee's sci-fi spectacle Raaka with Allu Arjun.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer Singh is riding high as the Dhurandhar franchise smashes box-office records, with the actor expecting baby number two alongside wife Deepika Padukone.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan stunned at Cannes 2026 in blush-pink couture for her 24th year on the red carpet, joined once again by daughter Aaradhya.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Newly married to Vijay Deverakonda, Rashmika Mandanna launched the Cocktail 2 trailer in June and is shooting the action-led Mysaa in a fierce new avatar.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha Ruth Prabhu dropped the trailer for Maa Inti Bangaaram and gave a keynote at Women in Entertainment 2026, settling into life after marrying Raj Nidimoru.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun officially announced his sci-fi actioner Raaka with director Atlee, even as he cheered brother Ram Charan's Peddi as a 'mind-blowing' performance.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's sports drama Peddi is a runaway hit, crossing ₹200 crore in India and entering the $5M overseas club within its opening week — his biggest solo lead yet.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR makes his Bollywood debut opposite Hrithik Roshan in War 2, confirmed for an IMAX release on August 14 as part of YRF's Spy Universe.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi Kapoor is basking in Peddi's blockbuster run beside Ram Charan, with her Oscar-shortlisted film Homebound also keeping her in the spotlight.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya Panday's musical romance Chand Mera Dil with Lakshya is in cinemas, and her OTT debut series Call Me Bae lands on Prime Video this September.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara Advani rounds out the high-octane trio of War 2 alongside Hrithik Roshan and Jr NTR, one of the year's most anticipated Bollywood spectacles.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik Roshan returns as RAW agent Kabir in War 2, hitting theatres and IMAX on August 14, with the much-hyped dance face-off against Jr NTR wrapping the shoot.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun Dhawan reunites with Janhvi Kapoor for Dharma's rom-com Sunny Sanskari Ki Tulsi Kumari, fresh off the blockbuster patriotic ensemble Border 2.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya Ghoshal kicks off the international leg of her Unstoppable Tour on June 20 in Auckland, with a string of US arena dates lined up through September.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman paid a stirring musical tribute to BSF soldiers at the Attari border for Main Vaapas Aaunga and is confirmed to score Mani Ratnam's next film.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay's party TVK emerged as the single-largest force in Tamil Nadu's 2026 Assembly elections, fueling fresh hype for his swansong film Jana Nayagan.
